fields.label: OCR Language
fields.description: Tesseract language code (e.g., 'lit' for Lithuanian, 'eng' for English, or multiple separated by '+' like 'lit+eng')

fields.label: OCR Config
fields.description: Tesseract configuration flags (--oem 3 uses LSTM, --psm 6 assumes uniform text block)

fields.label: Header Rows Limit
fields.description: Number of rows from top of document to consider as header region for extraction

fields.label: Row Threshold
fields.description: Pixel threshold for grouping OCR elements into rows based on Y coordinates

fields.label: Pending Document Cleanup Days
fields.description: Automatically delete Pending Documents with status Used, Moved, Split or Error when last modified is older than this many days

fields.label: Ignored IDs
fields.description: List of VAT codes and business IDs to exclude from extraction
